title.narrative: Sonar Music SA - Youth Leader Exchange

description.narrative: The Youth Leaders will be attached to Sonar Music - SA pilot project, which is based in Hilton, South Africa. The Youth Leader exchange aims to: ? Support the work of the partner organisation in empowering young people. ? Strengthen the partnership between Youth For Christ Denmark and Hilton Christian Fellowship. ? Strengthen the foundation of the project in South Africa with focus on administrative detail and leadership development. ? Strengthen monitoring and reporting process of pilot project. ? Support the events created by Sonar Music South Africa (for example the talent show and pop-up music clubs in Sweetwater?s) ? Raise awareness of the international opportunities for young people in Denmark. ? Focus on how the skills development in music production and event management can be utilised for Youth empowerment, Advocacy and agency. ? Strengthen connection between volunteers in Hilton club and Sweetwaters.
